title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (MERN)
description: Own what you build, from first commit to long after go-live. Anyone can ship a feature. What sets great engineers apart is what happens next: whether the system holds when traffic doubles overnight, how fast it recovers when something breaks, and whether the client’s product is still thriving a year on. Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, SaaS, Logistics, and EdTech. The domains change, but the bar doesn’t: secure, reliable, and ready to scale. We’re looking for a Senior MERN Stack Developer to build full-stack products with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js (TypeScript), and to stay accountable for them well beyond launch. What your role looks like Take features from idea to live: Drive work through design, build, release, and ongoing support, and remain the owner afterward. Build products that hold up under load: Create polished React interfaces and secure, well-tested Node/Express APIs on top of thoughtfully modeled MongoDB data. Set the standard for quality: Run constructive code reviews and champion readable, tested, maintainable code. Keep a steady hand when things break: Lead the response to incidents, restore service fast, and follow through with root-cause analysis so issues stay fixed. Shape how our platforms evolve: Help make the architecture and design decisions that matter. Grow the people around you: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and raise the team’s overall skill. Work as one team with product, design, QA, and DevOps: Get hands-on with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, and observability. See the world through the client’s eyes: Quickly understand each client’s users, goals, and constraints, and turn them into the right technical solutions. Your first 90 days Days 1–30, Learn and deliver: Get to know our codebases, tools, and people, and ship your first meaningful contribution. Days 31–60, Own something real: Take a feature or service end to end, and add your voice to code reviews and design discussions. Days 61–90, Become the go-to person: Be a dependable engineer on a core client product, handle production issues confidently, and start guiding teammates. What you bring 4+ years building full-stack web applications professionally Deep MERN expertise (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) with strong JavaScript and TypeScript Solid grounding in REST API design, MongoDB schema design and indexing, authentication and authorization, testing, and application security Experience with React state management and performance tuning (Redux, React Query, code splitting, etc.) A history of running production systems, not only building them Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) Comfort with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production monitoring and debugging Experience across different industries or product types, and the ability to ramp up fast on new domains A natural tendency to step up and take ownership when it’s needed Bonus points Strong system design skills: microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture Experience with Next.js, GraphQL, or WebSockets/real-time features Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience Familiarity with compliance standards such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2 Experience integrating third-party services like payment gateways (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen), CRMs, or analytics tools Background in a consultancy or product studio juggling multiple clients and projects Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot Why you’ll like it here Independent and profitable: No investor pressure or growth-at-any-cost targets. We play the long game. A truly global team: Collaborate with 80+ engineers across five hubs worldwide. Variety built in: Different industries and products keep your skills sharp. A voice that counts: You’ll influence our technical direction, and your role goes well beyond closing tickets.

You will partner closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Operations teams to deliver integrated capabilities and foster engineering excellence in an open, innovative culture. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and implement full‑stack solutions using .NET/C#, Angular, AWS and database interactions using SQL . Build and maintain cloud‑native, containerized microservices architectures. Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, and best‑practice implementation aligned with LPL SDLC and RM processes. Collaborate with cross‑functional teams (Product, Design, Platform, Ops) to deliver high‑quality, integrated solutions. Identify opportunities for application and process improvements; contribute to platform roadmaps and technical documentation. Maintain, troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance existing systems. Implement resiliency and security patterns (retry, circuit breaker, idempotency, least privilege). Modern Web Development Build responsive, accessible Angular (v16+) applications and MFEs using RxJS and modern UI patterns. Integrate front‑end applications with backend services using typed clients. AI‑Accelerated Engineering Use AI developer tools to accelerate code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, and reviews (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, CodeWhisperer). Apply human judgment and engineering standards to ensure correctness and security. Demonstrate measurable improvements in delivery efficiency and quality. Full SDLC Ownership Author unit, integration, and E2E tests (xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright/Cypress). Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated quality and security gates. Instrument applications with logging, metrics, tracing, and operational dashboards. Required Qualifications 5+ years of hands‑on full‑stack software development experience. 5+ years of experience designing and implementing complex, distributed systems. Strong experience with .NET/C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS, SQL & NoSQL . 5+ years of AWS cloud development and deployment experience, including EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, Athena, Glue, and EventBridge . Experience building ETL and data pipelines from structured and unstructured sources. Required Tools & Platforms Git‑based source control and pull‑request workflows. Agile tools such as Jira (or equivalent). CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps . API testing tools such as Postman . Code quality and security tools such as SonarQube/SonarLint and Snyk . AI‑assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot/Copilot Chat , Cursor , or similar. Preferred Qualifications Containerization and orchestration experience (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience in financial services, wealth management, or asset management. Reporting and data experience; Python (PySpark/NumPy) a plus. Experience with observability, feature‑flagging, and production support in regulated environments. Core Competencies Strong verbal and written communication skills. Excellent analytical, estimation, and problem‑solving abilities. Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute in a fast‑paced environment. Team‑oriented mindset with a passion for continuous learning and improvement.
